blockers.description: Gateway throughput ~76 output tok/s. During this session gsd-planner on opus TIMED OUT TWICE on plan 04-03 (once with an explicit 'operation timed out' API error, once returning empty with nothing written to disk). Plan sizes are the driver: 04-02 is 60KB, 04-04 41KB, 04-01 43KB.
blockers.workaround: Three levers used successfully: (1) chunked mode (workflow.plan_chunked=true) so each run writes one plan and commits it; (2) TRIM THE INPUTS — pre-extracting only the relevant slices of 04-UI-SPEC.md / 04-RESEARCH.md into small .*-extract.md files made the retry of 04-02 succeed where the full-file read had timed out; (3) drop to sonnet — 04-03 only completed on sonnet after two opus failures. ALWAYS check the filesystem before treating an empty Agent return as failure: EVERY successful planner run this session returned empty while having written its file.

decisions.decision: Switched model_profile from quality to adaptive
decisions.rationale: Role-based cost optimization. Under adaptive only 9 of 34 agents get the opus tier; in the plan/execute loop that is just gsd-planner. Verified by running the resolver directly rather than reading the profile table.

decisions.decision: Set models.planning=inherit instead of pinning a concrete Opus version
decisions.rationale: The user asked to pin gsd-planner to claude-opus-4-8. EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED THAT THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE: on the Claude runtime GSD structurally cannot emit a concrete Claude model ID. model_overrides.gsd-planner='claude-opus-4-8' resolves back to the bare alias 'opus' via CLAUDE_POLICY_ID_TO_ALIAS (model-resolver.cjs:216); a date-pinned variant warns and falls through to the same alias; the only path that emits a real ID (step 3, runtimeTierDefaults) is gated on `configRuntime !== 'claude'`. models.planning=inherit is the nearest working equivalent — planning-type agents follow the session model instead.

models.planning=inherit sweeps up gsd-pattern-mapper too (its phase type is also 'planning'), lifting it from haiku to the session model for what is a light task. The per-agent override is precedence step 1 and pushes it back down. Bare aliases pass through mapClaudeOverrideForRuntime unchanged, unlike full IDs.
User instruction: the researcher must not use the top-tier model and its effort must not exceed High. Matches the measured reality that opus researcher spawns timed out twice while sonnet completed.

Verifies that symbols cited in plans exist in source at review time, catching hallucinated names before execution. Relevant here because the four plans cite a large number of not-yet-existing symbols.

decisions.decision: Trimmed planner inputs into .*-extract.md scratch files instead of letting each chunked run read the full 48KB UI-SPEC / 46KB RESEARCH
decisions.rationale: This is what made the 04-02 retry succeed after a timeout. The insight: the PLANNER does not need design tokens or full research prose — it needs to know what to build and what to lift. The EXECUTOR reads the full spec via <read_first>. Reusable technique for any slow-gateway planning run.

All four PLAN.md files are written, committed, and passed the plan-checker with zero blockers; the phase is substantively planned. Two things worth carrying forward: (1) every single successful planner Agent call this session returned an EMPTY string while having written its file correctly — never treat an empty return as failure without checking disk first; (2) input trimming, not model choice, was the most effective fix for the timeouts. The session also spent significant time on model configuration; the durable finding is that GSD cannot pin a concrete Claude model ID on the Claude runtime by design, so `inherit` is the only real lever, and the attempt to move to Opus 4.8 was blocked by gateway authentication rather than by anything in GSD.
